_why: Supabase edge functions do not deploy from git. They are pushed with the CLI or the
Management API, which means the committed source and the running source can disagree
indefinitely and nothing complains. That is exactly how the H-12 mail outage survived:
wf-checkout-alerts, wf-guest-emails and wf-seo-lead-morning had already been moved to
Resend out-of-band, the repo still showed Brevo, and the 2026-08-15 audit read the repo
This file records what was deployed, at which version, from which source bytes.
scripts/check-edge-deploy-manifest.mjs fails the build when a listed function's source
changes without its entry being updated - i.e. when you edit a function and forget to
redeploy it. Update an entry only AFTER a successful deploy.
sha256 is computed over the file with all CR bytes removed, so it is identical on
Windows checkouts and Linux CI runners.

_shared/mailer.ts.note: Bundled into all five report functions. Changing this file requires redeploying every one of them.

_tracked_provenance: Pulled 2026-08-15 from the running source via the Supabase Management API, closing the
23-function gap this manifest previously only described. These entries are hash-guarded
exactly like "verified": editing one without redeploying fails the build.
They are listed separately from "verified" because the provenance is weaker. "verified"
means the function was deployed from this repo and then invoked to confirm it works.
"tracked" means the source was read back out of production and committed. Three entries
carry repo_differs_from_deployed: their live source contained plaintext credentials that
must never enter git history, so the committed copy substitutes env lookups. For those
three the repo is deliberately NOT byte-identical to production until the tokens are
rotated, the env vars set, and the function redeployed.
